```yaml
name: Copilot Agent Environment Setup

on:
  copilot:

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: oxc-project/setup-rust@v1

      - name: Set up Node.js and pnpm
        uses: oxc-project/setup-node@8958a8e040102244b619c4a94fccb657a44b1c21

      - name: Install just
        uses: extraction/setup-just@v3
        with:
          just-version: 1.13.0
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install cargo-binstall
        run: |
          cargo install cargo-binstall --locked
        shell: bash

      - name: Install development tools via cargo-binstall
        run: |
          cargo binstall --no-confirm watchexec-cli cargo-insta typos-cli cargo-shear dprint
        shell: bash

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: pnpm install
        shell: bash

      - name: Verify tool versions
        run: |
          echo "just version: $(just --version)"
          echo "cargo-binstall version: $(cargo-binstall --version)"
          echo "watchexec version: $(watchexec --version)"
          echo "cargo-insta version: $(cargo-insta --version)"
          echo "typos version: $(typos --version)"
          echo "cargo-shear version: $(cargo-shear --version)"
          echo "dprint version: $(dprint --version)"
          echo "node version: $(node --version)"
          echo "pnpm version: $(pnpm --version)"
          echo "rustc version: $(rustc --version)"
        shell: bash

      - name: Run cargo check
        run: cargo check
        shell: bash

      - name: Completion message
        run: |
          echo "✅ Copilot agent environment setup complete."
          echo "Available commands: just ready, just fmt, just test, just lint."
        shell: bash
```
